title: 第7章  唯一目的，就是杀你！
content_zh:
“哼！给我去死！”
被陆烬如此威胁，柳如烟不愿多说！
三年前魔窟内的秘密，只有他和杨巅峰知道，如今陆烬归来，她绝不为自己留后患！
而且，狐师让她拿下陆烬身上的机缘，眼下，正是最佳时机！
话音落下，玉手舞动，一道灵气滚滚如潮，其中一把金色长剑发出清越剑吟，剧烈剑芒刺得人睁不开眼睛！
“圣女竟动用了黄金太阳剑！”
“有幸目睹圣女施展此地阶战兵，今天算是来着了！”
“圣女曾以此剑斩杀过二品金丹强者！如今她实力大增，战力恐怕能对抗三品金丹！”
“圣女的实力，根本不是罗鹫长老能比得了的，杀陆烬，易如反掌！”
“……”
一出手便杀机滚滚，一些弟子已经惊呼着撤到了数百丈之外。
“我已无限接近二品金丹，这黄金太阳剑更是万剑宗七大至宝之一，能让我的战力大增！陆烬，你拿什么跟我斗！”
柳如烟气息冽冽，说话间，黄金太阳剑已经飞刺而来，悬于陆烬头顶！
璀璨剑芒，散发出逼人寒意。
看到她这般穷凶极恶，陆烬冷笑：
“柳如烟，你如此迫不及待要杀我，是怕我将魔窟中发生的事情公诸于众？”
“呵，我现在已没那个心思，既然这个世界的规则是弱肉强食，那我也不奢求万剑宗能还我公道，而且这一帮被你蒙蔽之人，想必全是跟罗鹫之流一样，主动选择执迷不悟！”
“既如此，今日，我不会再奢望什么，唯一目的，便是杀你！”
陆烬话音刚落，全身气息爆发，再次施展出五百剑斩！
玄品高阶武学百剑斩，修炼达到巅峰，最高可凝聚九百飞剑！

不过，其消耗相当巨大，一般修士根本无法承受，所以在万剑宗内，哪怕是那神龙见首不见尾的宗主，曾经在修炼出六百飞剑之后，也将其舍弃，转而修炼其他剑法了。
之前陆烬能施展出五百剑，如今再次动用，在众人看来，他已外强中干！
只不过，那是对普通人而言，对如今的陆烬来说，可远没到他的极限！
“区区玄阶高阶剑法罢了，就算你能凝聚出传说中的九百飞剑又如何？”
柳如烟不屑嗤笑：
“本圣女一剑破之！”
黄金太阳剑金光如瀑，似与天上耀阳交相辉映，随着柳如烟的手指舞动，直接冲向五百飞剑，大有一剑破万剑的强势。
而地阶战兵的强大，也瞬间显现了出来，五百灵气凝聚的飞剑，虽气势也颇为惊人，但因品阶所限，的确要被柳如烟压制一筹。
双方战兵在半空交击，顿时爆发出震破虚空的巨响。
五百飞剑在黄金太阳剑冲击之下，纷纷爆炸，灵气乱流冲向四面八方。
而陆烬的气势，也逐渐被压制下来。
“哼，我就说嘛，他根本没资格跟圣女抗衡！”
“圣女无论是修为还是战兵，都要压他一头，想战胜圣女，痴人说梦！”
“能以玄阶武学跟圣女僵持到现在，已经很不错了，死了也值了。”
“……”
人群中发出幸灾乐祸的笑声，不过，其中却也有些弟子面色变得复杂几分。
若陆烬之前所说都是真的，那他们这些人哪怕袖手旁观，也是有罪的！
可弱肉强食的世界，弱小者哪有追求公平正义的资格！
黄金太阳剑强势席卷，蕴含恐怖波动的剑芒将一片空间荡漾成金色，似乎其中一切都能被金光绞杀！
而陆烬所施展的五百飞剑，在坚持了十数个呼吸后，也彻底崩碎，荡然无存！

最后只剩下一道薄如蝉翼的光膜笼罩周身，看上去不堪一击。
黄金太阳剑却没有再进一步，凌空悬浮，剑尖对准陆烬，杀意凛冽。
“能引动雷劫又如何？陆烬，临死前，就让你尝尝至尊骨的味道！”
柳如烟此番不可谓不恶毒！
用从陆烬身上夺来的至尊骨杀他，杀人诛心！
众人视线里，陆烬此刻所有的攻势全部崩溃，似已失去抵抗之力。
可柳如烟此时非但没有收手，反而将至尊骨之力祭出，加持在黄金太阳剑下！
这般做法，无疑想让陆烬死无葬身之地！
“哈哈哈！陆烬，你死定了！”
看到这一幕，那罗鹫等长老忽然哈哈大笑起来。
之前他们被陆烬打压，甚至差点殒命，此时看到陆烬被柳如烟彻底压制无力招架，内心畅快无比！
然而，他话音还未落下，却忽然听到虚空被道道尖锐鸣响划破。
陆烬头顶，那些被柳如烟冲爆的五百飞剑，竟于须臾间再次凝聚了出来！
这一次，数量几乎倍增！
“九……九百飞剑？这怎么可能！”
“不会吧？传闻百剑斩修炼至登峰造极，可凝聚九百飞剑，可从来没有人亲眼见过啊！他居然凝聚出了九百飞剑？”
“这个陆烬，到底身怀何等奇遇？他才五重灵珠境，便能将百剑斩修炼至化境，简直难以置信！”
所有人都被这一幕震惊了，大张着嘴巴，满眼难以置信！
“九百飞剑？这倒是有点意思……”
坐镇于此的姬邀月，此时也眸色一变。

显然，若说陆烬之前的五百飞剑并没有让她惊讶的话，那么此时那悬浮半空的九百飞剑，却足以让她心惊！
毕竟连宗主都只修炼出了六百飞剑，而当时的宗主，已经是三品金丹境强者！
“九百飞剑？呵呵，我倒是小瞧你了！”
柳如烟眸色也是一变，陆烬再次让她大感意外！
从得知之前那雷劫是因陆烬而起，她内心就隐隐浮现出一抹不安。
毕竟，三年前那个陆烬并不是傻子，除了拥有强大战力之外，他心思还相当缜密，根本不会干没有把握之事！
一念至此，她更觉不安，因为，陆烬胆敢如此大张旗鼓归来寻自己复仇，一定身怀更大底牌！
“九百飞剑并不可怕，他身上更厉害的，是那股防御力量！”
这时候，柳如烟脑袋里一个声音响起。
“狐师，还请指教！”
“那防御看上去单薄，却防御力惊人！你此番攻击，务必将重点放在刺穿他的防御之上，防御不破，一切都是徒劳！”
“是！”
柳如烟抬眸看向陆烬，眸色冰寒：
“没想到你还真能凝聚九百飞剑，不过，也就到此为止了！”
话落，黄金太阳剑骤然刺出，冲向九百飞剑！
与此同时，那至尊骨虚影之上，一道骨符闪烁了一下，化为一道光刃，冲向龙膜中的陆烬！
黄金太阳剑是超级战兵，而至尊骨光刃，则是至强杀手锏！
双管齐下！
场中又是一阵轰鸣！
黄金太阳剑威风凛凛，哪怕陆烬施展的九百飞剑规模庞大，却依旧被金色长剑不断斩碎。

狂暴乱流再次席卷，现场混乱程度让人头皮发麻！
不过，这声势浩大的攻击，却并不是柳如烟的真正杀招。
至尊骨光刃的攻击，早已刺入龙膜防御，企图将其撕裂。
“用我的至尊骨之力杀我？贱人！”
陆烬眸色冰冷，下一秒却惊讶看到，那光刃的攻击突然停滞，似乎被一股强大力量压制住了。
“嗯？”
陆烬皱眉，这才感受到，那股力量来自于体内！
“帝霸琉璃骨？”
“在绝世帝骨面前，你这至尊骨啥也不是！”
他现在虽然对帝霸琉璃骨的神秘一无所知，可当至尊骨的攻击袭来，它却能发出诡异力量将其压制，或许这就相当于妖兽间的血脉压制，无形，却存在。
陆烬也不拖沓，一道灵力缠绕而上，将那至尊骨光刃直接封锁起来。
这一瞬，柳如烟面色一变！
不光是她，姬邀月的黛眉也微微皱起：
“看来，本座还是低估了你……”
九百飞剑不断爆炸，却持续了很久，以至于那黄金太阳剑的光芒都暗淡了下去！
可所有攻击全部在防御龙膜之外，并没对陆烬造成半点伤害。
反而那狂暴乱流逼迫得柳如烟不得不躲闪防御，倒显得比陆烬狼狈了几分！
而更恐怖的是，当九百飞剑再次被柳如烟全部斩碎，陆烬头顶竟再次浮现出九百飞剑！
现场所有人都懵逼了！
这还是人？

那罗鹫更是震惊的一句话都说不出来！
之前陆烬对付他们，本以为他施展出三百飞剑已是极限，如今九百又九百，简直天方夜谭！
要是陆烬一上来就施展如此杀招，他现在怕是已经过奈何桥了！
此刻的柳如烟也心惊肉跳起来，一双眸子满是难以置信！
她手中的黄金太阳剑虽强，却需要充沛灵气作为支撑，而此时这把剑的能量几乎消耗了一半，黯淡下去许多！
而对方的飞剑却像是连绵不绝！
太难缠了！
而更让她意外的是，她发出的至尊骨光刃，竟没泛起半点波澜！
那道光刃的毁灭之力，比起黄金太阳剑还要强，却依旧没能对陆烬造成半点伤害！
这家伙到底身怀怎样的不为人知的手段？
一时间，她要斩杀陆烬的勇气都被削弱了几分。
陆烬头顶九百飞剑悬浮，可他身上的气息，却淡然如水，看不出半点凌厉。
“柳如烟，到现在你还不承认，那至尊骨是抢了我的么？”
陆烬话落，那封锁至尊骨光刃的灵气散开，当看到那至尊骨光刃之时，众人眸色皆是一惊！
“你抢的至尊骨，可跟我同根同源，你用它来攻击我？”
陆烬冷冷一笑，旋即手掌一握！
那光刃直接炸开！
与此同时，悬浮于柳如烟头顶的至尊骨虚影忽然一颤，气机感应之下，柳如烟瞳孔一缩，一口鲜血从嘴角溢出！
这一刻，所有人眸色大惊！
“果然……圣女果然是抢了陆烬的至尊骨！”

“原来陆烬说的都是真的！”
content_en:
"Hmph! Go to hell!"
Being threatened like this by Lu Jin, Liu Ruyan didn't want to say more!
Only he and Yang Dingfeng knew the secrets in the Demon Cave three years ago. Now that Lu Jin is back, she will never leave any trouble for herself!
Moreover, Master Fox gave her the opportunity to take over Lu Jin, so now is the best time!
After the words fell, the jade hands danced, and a stream of spiritual energy rolled like a tide. One of the golden long swords let out a Qingyue sword chant, and the sword light stabbed so fiercely that people couldn't open their eyes!
"The Saint actually used the Golden Sun Sword!"
"I'm lucky enough to witness the saint using this level of warriors. It's a good day today!"
"The saint once killed a second-grade golden elixir expert with this sword! Now her strength has greatly increased, and her combat power may be able to fight against a third-grade golden elixir!"
"The Saintess's strength is simply not comparable to that of Elder Luo Jiu. Killing Lu Jin is as easy as a piece of cake!"
"..."
As soon as he made a move, he was filled with murderous intent, and some disciples had already retreated hundreds of feet away in shock.
"I am infinitely close to the second-grade golden elixir. This golden sun sword is one of the seven treasures of the Ten Thousand Swords Sect. It can greatly increase my combat power! Lu Jin, what are you going to fight with me for?"
Liu Ruyan's breath was sharp, and as he spoke, the Golden Sun Sword was already flying towards Lu Jin, hanging above his head!
The dazzling sword glow exuded a chilling chill.
Seeing her being so vicious, Lu Jin sneered:
"Liu Ruyan, you are so eager to kill me, are you afraid that I will make what happened in the devil's cave public to the public?"
"Ha, I no longer have that intention. Since the rule of this world is that the weak eat the strong, then I don't expect justice from Wanjian Sect. Moreover, these people who have been deceived by you must all be like Luo Jiu and others, who actively choose to be stubborn!"
"In this case, today, I will not expect anything more. My only purpose is to kill you!"
As soon as Lu Jin finished speaking, his whole body's aura erupted, and he performed another five hundred sword cuts!
Xuanpin high-level martial arts hundred swords slashing, reaching the peak of cultivation, and can condense up to nine hundred flying swords!
However, its consumption is quite huge, and ordinary monks cannot bear it at all. Therefore, in the Ten Thousand Swords Sect, even the sect leader who has never seen the dragon has its head and tail, abandoned it after practicing the Six Hundred Flying Swords, and turned to other swordsmanship.
Lu Jin could use the Five Hundred Swords before, but now he used it again. In the eyes of everyone, he was already strong on the outside but strong on the inside!
However, that was for ordinary people, but for Lu Jin today, it was far from his limit!
"It's just a high-level Xuan-level swordsmanship, so what if you can condense the legendary Nine Hundred Flying Swords?"
Liu Ruyan sneered disdainfully:
"This holy lady will destroy it with one sword!"
The Golden Sun Sword's golden light was like a waterfall, seeming to complement the bright sun in the sky. Following the dance of Liu Ruyan's fingers, it rushed directly towards the five hundred flying swords, with the power of one sword to break ten thousand swords.
The power of the earth-level soldiers was also instantly revealed. Although the flying sword condensed with five hundred spiritual energy was quite astonishing in momentum, due to the limitations of the level, it was indeed suppressed by Liu Ruyan.
Soldiers from both sides clashed in mid-air, and a loud noise shook the void.
Five hundred flying swords exploded one after another under the impact of the Golden Sun Sword, and the spiritual energy rushed in all directions.
And Lu Jin's momentum was gradually suppressed.
"Hmph, let me tell you, he is not qualified to compete with the Saint!"
"No matter whether the saint is a warrior or a warrior, she will overwhelm him. Wanting to defeat the saint is a fool's errand!"
"Being able to maintain a stalemate with the Saint with Xuan-level martial arts until now is already very good. It's worth dying."
"..."
The crowd burst into gloating laughter, but some disciples among them had complex expressions.
If what Lu Jin said before is true, then they are still guilty even if they stand by and watch!
But in a world where the weak eat the strong, how can the weak have the qualifications to pursue fairness and justice?
The golden sun sword swept across with force, and the sword light containing terrifying fluctuations rippled the space into gold, as if everything in it could be strangled by the golden light!
And Lu JinThe Five Hundred Flying Swords he used, after holding on for more than ten breaths, completely collapsed and disappeared!
In the end, there was only a film of light as thin as cicada wings covering the whole body, looking vulnerable.
The Golden Sun Sword did not take any further. It was suspended in the air, the tip of the sword pointed at Lu Jin, with murderous intent.
"So what if it can trigger thunder? Lu Jin, before you die, I will let you taste the taste of the Supreme Bone!"
Liu Ruyan is very vicious this time!
Use the Supreme Bone that was taken from Lu Jin to kill him and kill him!
In everyone's sight, all Lu Jin's offensives collapsed at this moment, and he seemed to have lost his ability to resist.
But Liu Ruyan not only did not stop at this time, but instead sacrificed the power of the Supreme Bone and blessed it under the Golden Sun Sword!
Such an approach would undoubtedly make Lu Jin die without a burial place!
"Hahaha! Lu Jin, you are dead!"
Seeing this scene, Luo Jiu and other elders suddenly laughed.
They were suppressed by Lu Jin before and almost died. Now seeing Lu Jin being completely suppressed by Liu Ruyan and unable to resist, they felt extremely happy!
However, before he finished speaking, he suddenly heard the void being cut through by sharp sounds.
Above Lu Jin's head, the five hundred flying swords exploded by Liu Ruyan suddenly condensed again in an instant!
This time, the number has almost doubled!
"Nine...nine hundred flying swords? How is this possible!"
"No way? It is said that after practicing the Hundred Sword Slash to the peak, you can condense nine hundred flying swords, but no one has ever seen it with your own eyes! He actually condensed nine hundred flying swords?"
"What kind of adventure does this Lu Jin have? He is only at the fifth level of the Spiritual Bead Realm, but he can practice the Hundred Sword Slash to the Transformation Realm. It is simply unbelievable!"
Everyone was shocked by this scene, with their mouths wide open and their eyes full of disbelief!
"Nine hundred flying swords? This is quite interesting..."
Ji Yaoyue, who was sitting here, also changed her eyes at this time.
Obviously, if Lu Jin's five hundred flying swords before had not surprised her, then the nine hundred flying swords suspended in mid-air at this time were enough to scare her!
After all, even the sect master had only cultivated six hundred flying swords, and the sect master at that time was already a third-grade golden elixir realm expert!
"Nine hundred flying swords? Haha, I underestimated you!"
The color of Liu Ruyan's eyes also changed, Lu Jin surprised her again!
Ever since she learned that the thunder catastrophe was caused by Lu Jin, she felt a hint of uneasiness in her heart.
After all, the Lu Jin three years ago was not a fool. In addition to having strong combat power, he was also very thoughtful and would never do anything he was unsure of!
At this thought, she felt even more uneasy, because Lu Jin must have a bigger trump card if he dared to come back in such a big way to seek revenge on her!
"Nine Hundred Flying Swords are not scary. What's even more powerful about him is his defensive power!"
At this time, a voice sounded in Liu Ruyan's head.
"Master Fox, please give me some advice!"
"The defense looks thin, but its defense power is amazing! Your attack must focus on piercing his defense. If the defense is not broken, everything will be in vain!"
"Yes!"
Liu Ruyan raised her eyes to look at Lu Jin, her eyes cold:
"I didn't expect you to be able to gather nine hundred flying swords, but that's about it!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the Golden Sun Sword suddenly thrust out and rushed towards the Nine Hundred Flying Swords!
At the same time, a bone talisman flashed above the supreme bone shadow, turned into a light blade, and rushed towards Lu Jin in the dragon film!
The Golden Sun Sword is a super soldier, and the Supreme Bone Light Blade is the most powerful weapon!
A two-pronged approach!
There was another roar in the field!
The Golden Sun Sword was majestic. Even though the Nine Hundred Flying Swords used by Lu Jin were huge, they were still chopped into pieces by the golden sword.
Violent turbulence swept across again, and the level of chaos on the scene was mind-numbing!
However, this massive attack was not Liu Ruyan's real killer move.
The attack of the Supreme Bone Light Blade has already penetrated the dragon membrane defense, trying to tear it apart.
"With my supreme boneThe power to kill me? Bitch! "
Lu Jin's eyes were cold, and the next second he was surprised to see that the attack of the light blade suddenly stopped, as if it was suppressed by a powerful force.
"Huh? "
Lu Jin frowned, and then he felt that the power came from within his body!
"Emperor Glazed Bones? "
“In front of the Peerless Emperor Bone, your Supreme Bone is nothing! "
Although he now knows nothing about the mystery of the Emperor's Glazed Bone, when the Supreme Bone's attack comes, it can emit strange power to suppress it. Perhaps this is equivalent to the suppression of blood among monsters and beasts. It is invisible, but exists.
Lu Jin did not hesitate, and a stream of spiritual power wrapped around him, directly sealing the Supreme Bone Light Blade.
At this moment, Liu Ruyan's expression changed!
Not only her, Ji Yaoyue's eyebrows also wrinkled slightly:
"It seems that I have underestimated you..."
The Nine Hundred Flying Swords continued to explode, but they lasted for a long time, so that the light of the golden sun sword dimmed!
But all the attacks were outside the defensive dragon film and did not cause any damage to Lu Jin.
On the contrary, the violent turbulence forced Liu Ruyan to dodge and defend, which made him look even more embarrassed than Lu Jin!
What was even more terrifying was that when the Nine Hundred Flying Swords were all chopped into pieces by Liu Ruyan again, the Nine Hundred Flying Swords appeared above Lu Jin's head again!
Everyone at the scene was stunned!
Is this still a human being?
Luo Jiu was even more shocked and couldn't say a word!
When Lu Jin dealt with them before, he thought that three hundred flying swords would be his limit, but now nine hundred and nine hundred are simply a fantasy!
If Lu Jin had used such a killing move as soon as he came up, he would have crossed the Naihe Bridge by now!
At this moment, Liu Ruyan was also frightened, her eyes were full of disbelief!
Although the golden sun sword in her hand is powerful, it needs abundant spiritual energy to support it. At this time, the sword's energy has been almost half consumed, and it has become much bleaker!
But the opponent's flying swords seemed to be continuous!
So difficult!
What surprised her even more was that the Supreme Bone Light Blade she emitted did not cause any ripples!
The destructive power of that light blade was stronger than the Golden Sun Sword, but it still failed to cause any damage to Lu Jin!
What kind of unknown tricks does this guy have?
For a moment, her courage to kill Lu Jin was weakened.
Nine hundred flying swords were suspended above Lu Jin's head, but the aura on his body was as calm as water, without any hint of sharpness.
"Liu Ruyan, you still haven't admitted it yet, did the Supreme Bone rob me? "
After Lu Jin finished speaking, the aura that blocked the Supreme Bone Light Blade dispersed. When they saw the Supreme Bone Light Blade, everyone's eyes were shocked!
"The Supreme Bone you grabbed has the same origin as mine, and you use it to attack me? "
Lu Jin smiled coldly and immediately shook his hands!
The light blade exploded directly!
At the same time, the Supreme Bone Shadow suspended above Liu Ruyan's head suddenly trembled. Under the induction of Qi, Liu Ruyan's pupils shrank, and a mouthful of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth!
At this moment, everyone’s eyes were shocked!
"Sure enough... the saint really stole Lu Jin's supreme bone! "
"It turns out that everything Lu Jin said is true! "
